title: Don’t order the red one!!!
text: Don’t order the red one!!!. Only giving one star because I Ordered 2 of these the black one was great , the red one I got 2 replacements both defective. Seller was quick to respond but it’s a huge waste of my time to have to send 2 of these items back and repack. I wouldn’t get the red one because they seem to have been cut wrong .

description: The Spore Upholstered Bench features linen upholstery, a button tufted seat, an assortment of colors and a black wood finish. The transitional style of this bench works great at the dining table, in your bedroom or as an accent piece around your house.
